ai_summary: Bandhan Bank Limited has formally amended its Code of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI), aligning with the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. The updated code introduces stricter protocols for prompt and uniform information dissemination, designates the CFO as the Chief Investor Relations Officer, mandates 'need-to-know' sharing for legitimate purposes, and requires a Structured Digital Database for all UPSI, collectively enhancing governance and transparency around sensitive information management with no apparent red flags.
